evidence.quote: There are 2 LTS releases per year:
We support 1 LTS version per cycle and a max of 2 LTS versions in parallel
However once the Cycle LTS is released, it replaces the Intermediate one since we support only 1 LTS per Cycle.
The 17.4.x intermediate LTS branch will be supported in parallel to the LTS branch until the end of the year, for more details see our versioning and release practices .
The 18.4.x intermediate LTS branch will be supported in parallel to the LTS branch until the end of the year, for more details see our versioning and release practices .
The XWiki development team is proud to announce the availability of XWiki 18.7.0 .

"Critical" security issues: We’ll release fixes on all supported branches within 90 days (up to 30 days to start working on a fix, up to 30 days to develop a fix, and up to 30 days to release new versions on all supported branches).

research.summary: Open-source enterprise wiki and collaboration software.
research.notes: Researched from XWiki's official release policy, announcements, download page, security policy, and official GitHub release catalog on 2026-09-23. XWiki publishes 2 LTS releases per year, follows a monthly minor-release cadence, and supports a maximum of two LTS versions in parallel; these are policy and cadence, not lifecycle dates. Critical security issues have a 90-day remediation SLA, which is not a branch end date. Current support is not EOL. The 18.4 announcement's end-of-year wording is an upper bound until the exact 18.10.2 replacement release is published. The 18.7 download cell conflicts with the final announcement and GitHub publication date, so 2026-08-31 is used and the 24 August cell is not used. Historical 13.10, 14.10, 15.4, 15.10, 16.4, and 16.10 branches have unknown terminal dates; absence from the download page and later backports do not establish EOL.
